tools.description: Create a project, book 1, and chapter 1
tools.name: create_project

branch_id.description:
Id of the project's main bible branch. Each project gets its own main
branch (per-project main branch design, Phase 6); the SurrealDB era
had a singleton `bible_branch:main` shared globally — that assumption
is no longer valid. `#[serde(default)]` keeps older clients that
don't send this field on round-trips compatible.

tools.description: List all projects with their record ids
tools.name: list_projects

project_id.description: Record id to use with other tools (e.g. "project:abc123def")

tools.description: Persist the default project and branch for this MCP session so follow-up tool calls can omit project_id and use the current branch by default
tools.name: set_active_project

tools.description: Create the next book within a project
tools.name: create_book

tools.description: Create the next chapter within a book using book_number or book_id; optional chapter_number may be any unused non-negative number (gaps are allowed, e.g. for restructures) and defaults to one past the current maximum
tools.name: create_chapter

title.description:
The chapter's effective title after the call: the supplied title when
it was applied, otherwise the title the chapter already had (the
ensure path can return a pre-existing row). `None` when untitled.

tools.description: List the embedded Spindle workflow skills and craft references. Tool equivalent of browsing bible://skills/* and bible://references/*; use get_skill / get_reference to read one.

available_units.description: Skill and reference units covered by the active session profile.

covered.description: Whether the active tool profile covers all tools required by this skill.

markdown.description: Actionable workflow instructions when covered, or a profile-selection message when uncovered.

missing_capabilities.description: Required tool capabilities missing from the active session profile.

required_profile.description: Smallest tool profile that covers this skill.

tools.description: Return the full content of an embedded craft reference. Tool equivalent of reading bible://references/{name}.

missing_capabilities.description: Required tool capabilities missing from the active session profile.

name.description: Craft reference or response contract name.

required_profile.description: Smallest tool profile that covers this reference.

profile.description: Generated profile name to activate for this MCP session (for example "workflow-write", "research", or "full").

tools.name: use_profile

profile.description: Active profile name after the switch.

tool_count.description: Number of tools now visible in this session.

at_scene_id.description:
Optional explicit scene cursor. When omitted, Spindle derives the cursor
from the most recent written scene on the branch.

branch_id.description: Optional explicit branch. Defaults to the active branch.

budget_tokens.description: Preferred token budget for markdown rendering metadata.

include_recent_activity.description: Include derived recent activity. Defaults to true.

include_subjects.description: Include derived subject snapshots. Defaults to true.

project_id.description: Record id returned by create_project (for example "project:abc123def")

recent_activity_limit.description: Maximum number of recent activity entries to include. Defaults to 20.

tools.description: Start or resume a durable planning session for a new or existing project. Records the premise and optional horizon, budget and gate policy, then returns the session and the next safe action. Never starts drafting. Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/planning_begin (also available through get_reference).

inputSchema.description: Start a new planning session or resume an existing one.

allow_review_backend.description: Allow a configured review agent as a planning backend.

branch_id.description: Branch to bind; defaults to the project's active branch.

budget.description: Token and call ceiling for route generation.

input_cost_per_million_usd.description: Optional configured input price in US dollars per million tokens.

max_cost_usd.description: Optional hard cost ceiling in US dollars.

max_input_tokens.description: Maximum input tokens the session may spend.

max_model_calls.description: Maximum number of route calls across the whole session.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens the session may spend.

max_output_tokens_per_call.description: Maximum output tokens requested from a single route call.

max_total_tokens.description: Maximum combined input plus output tokens.

output_cost_per_million_usd.description: Optional configured output price in US dollars per million tokens.

horizon.description: Detailed chapter horizon to generate; defaults to three chapters with two scenes each.

book_number.description: Book number the detailed plan covers (1-based).

chapter_end.description: Last chapter in the detailed planning horizon, inclusive.

chapter_start.description: First chapter in the detailed planning horizon (1-based).

scenes_per_chapter.description: Planned scene count for each chapter in the horizon.

policy.description: Gate policy override; omission keeps every level human-gated.

gates.description: Gate to apply at each planning level; omitted levels keep human review.

book.description: Gate for the Book level; this root requires human review.

cast_world.description: Gate for the CastWorld level; this root requires human review.

contract.description: Gate for the Contract level; this root requires human review.

series_arc.description: Gate for the SeriesArc level; this root requires human review.

max_advisory_findings.description: Maximum advisory findings allowed for delegated chapter or scene acceptance.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for an explicitly delegated policy version.

policy_version.description: Monotonic policy version recorded with delegated decisions.

policy_actor.description: Human author recorded as ratifying the policy override.

policy_note.description: Note explaining why the policy override is authorized.

premise.description: One- to three-sentence premise or intent for a new planning session.

project_id.description: Existing project to bind; omit for a brand-new book.

rating_ceiling.description: Highest content rating the plan may request.

session_id.description: Existing planning session to resume instead of starting a new one.

tools.name: planning_begin

tools.description: Generate one planning level, submit a host-authored artifact when no route is available, retry a rejected attempt, recompute readiness, or update the session gate policy. Returns stage status, findings, usage and the next action. Proposals are identity-only by default; pass include_payloads=true to return their operations. Host prompts are bounded and large parent payloads are referenced by proposal id and hash. Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/planning_advance (also available through get_reference).

inputSchema.description: Generate, submit, retry, recheck or repolicy one planning level.

action.description: Action to perform; defaults to generating the next level.

allow_review_backend.description: Allow a configured review agent as a planning backend for this call.

branch_id.description: Branch the session is bound to; defaults to the project's active branch.

budget.description: Token and call ceiling for this call.

input_cost_per_million_usd.description: Optional configured input price in US dollars per million tokens.

max_cost_usd.description: Optional hard cost ceiling in US dollars.

max_input_tokens.description: Maximum input tokens the session may spend.

max_model_calls.description: Maximum number of route calls across the whole session.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens the session may spend.

max_output_tokens_per_call.description: Maximum output tokens requested from a single route call.

max_total_tokens.description: Maximum combined input plus output tokens.

output_cost_per_million_usd.description: Optional configured output price in US dollars per million tokens.

checkpoint_policy.description: Checkpoint policy applied when checking authoring readiness.

host_artifact.description: Host-authored artifact payload used by the stage_host_artifact action.

include_payloads.description:
Include full proposal operations and schedule in the response.
Defaults to false; the compact form returns identifier, level, status
and payload hash only.

level.description: Planning level to generate; defaults to the first unfilled level.

mining_policy.description: Canon-mining policy applied when checking authoring readiness.

parents.description: Exact accepted or staged parent proposal hashes; defaults to active ancestors.

policy.description: Gate policy override used by the set_policy action.

gates.description: Gate to apply at each planning level; omitted levels keep human review.

book.description: Gate for the Book level; this root requires human review.

cast_world.description: Gate for the CastWorld level; this root requires human review.

contract.description: Gate for the Contract level; this root requires human review.

series_arc.description: Gate for the SeriesArc level; this root requires human review.

policy_version.description: Monotonic policy version recorded with delegated decisions.

policy_actor.description: Human author recorded as ratifying a policy change.

policy_note.description: Note explaining why a policy change is authorized.

project_id.description: Project the session is bound to; omit to use the stored scope.

rating_ceiling.description: Highest content rating the generated plan may request.

retry_key.description: Caller-supplied idempotency key that prevents duplicate generation attempts.

target_range.description: Detailed chapter horizon for this generation call.

chapter_end.description: Last chapter in the detailed planning horizon, inclusive.

inputSchema.title: PlanningAdvanceInput

tools.name: planning_advance

tools.description: Read compact planning status: active sessions, staged proposals, gate, findings, readiness and the real authoring prepare report. Omit session_id to reconnect to existing planning work. By default each proposal returns only proposal_id, level, status and payload_hash; pass include_payloads=true or name proposal_ids to fetch operations. Superseded and rejected proposals are omitted unless named. Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/planning_status (also available through get_reference).

inputSchema.description: Read compact planning status for one session or for reconnect discovery.

branch_id.description: Branch whose sessions should be listed; defaults to the project's active branch.

include_payloads.description:
Include full operations and schedule for every returned proposal.
Defaults to false; the compact form returns identifier, level, status
and payload hash only.

include_readiness.description: Whether to include planner checks and the authoring prepare report.

project_id.description: Existing project whose sessions should be listed.

proposal_ids.description:
Return these proposals only, including full payloads even when
`include_payloads` is false. Use this to fetch a superseded or rejected
proposal by id without loading every payload.

session_id.description: Existing planning session to inspect; omit to discover active sessions.

target_range.description: Chapter range to check instead of the session's stored horizon.

book_number.description: Book number the detailed plan covers (1-based).

chapter_end.description: Last chapter in the detailed planning horizon, inclusive.

chapter_start.description: First chapter in the detailed planning horizon (1-based).

scenes_per_chapter.description: Planned scene count for each chapter in the horizon.

tools.description: Record a human accept, reject, revise or supersede decision for staged planning proposals, or prepare the authoring run from a ready session. Revise supersedes the selected proposals so a replacement can be staged. Requires exact proposal hashes for decisions and never drafts prose. Full response schema: bible://contracts/tools/v1/planning_decide (also available through get_reference).

expected_hashes.description: Exact proposal IDs and payload hashes the decision covers.

include_payloads.description:
Include full proposal operations and schedule in the response.

and payload hash only.

mining_policy.description: Canon-mining policy applied when preparing the authoring run.

project_id.description: Project the session is bound to; omit to use the stored scope.

target_range.description: Chapter range to prepare instead of the session's stored horizon.

book_number.description: Book number the detailed plan covers (1-based).
